data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nqr', meaning 'to be light' or 'to be delicate'. In Islamic tradition, Noqra represents the epitome of grace and elegance. The name Noqra carries the meaning “Elegance, Delicacy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Noqra usually hope their child will grow to embody elegance, delicacy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
